import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Bar chart - Amount by Transaction Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
type_amounts = df.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(type_amounts))
bars = ax1.bar(type_amounts.index, type_amounts.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Amount ($)')
ax1.set_title('Total Amount by Transaction Type')
for bar, val in zip(bars, type_amounts.values):
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height() + 5, 
             f'${val:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 2. Scatter plot - Amount vs Hour of Day
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
transaction_colors = {'payment': '#2ecc71', 'refund': '#e74c3c', 'transfer': '#3498db'}
for t_type in df['transaction_type'].unique():
    subset = df[df['transaction_type'] == t_type]
    ax2.scatter(subset['hour_of_day'], subset['amount'], 
                c=transaction_colors.get(t_type, 'gray'), 
                label=t_type, s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax2.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount by Hour of Day')
ax2.legend(title='Type')
ax2.set_xlim(0, 24)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Pie chart - Transaction Type Distribution (Count)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
type_counts = df['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = [transaction_colors.get(t, 'gray') for t in type_counts.index]
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie,
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(type_counts), shadow=True)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Type Distribution')

# 4. Box plot / Individual points - Amount Distribution by Type
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.stripplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', ax=ax4, 
              palette=transaction_colors, size=12, jitter=True, alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')
ax4.set_title('Amount Distribution by Transaction Type')
ax4.grid(True, axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Add summary statistics as text
summary_text = f"Total Transactions: {len(df)}\nTotal Amount: ${df['amount'].sum():.2f}\nAvg Amount: ${df['amount'].mean():.2f}\nFraud Cases: {df['is_fraud'].sum()}"
fig.text(0.02, 0.02, summary_text, fontsize=9, verticalalignment='bottom',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.05, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
